data.name: Nicolais
data.gender_notes: Nicolais is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Nicolais is recorded in name-lists as “Victory of the people”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nicolais expresses “Victory of the people”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicolais total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: ניקולאי
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות - שם נבואי, נוצרי, נקרא על שם קדוש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: משמעות ארוכה - שם נבואי, נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית, נקרא על שם קדוש, עם רקע דתי, משמעות של נבואה ושלום, המופיע בברית החדשה, בבשורה על-פי מתי (מתי 10:13) ובשולי (שולי 3:16)

in_greek.name: Νικόλαος
